assumptions: annual observations are aligned by year
trend extrapolation is an exploratory baseline, not a climate mechanism
objective: 在独立可运行脚本中复现历史草稿的模型比较、阈值预测和统计检验，并留下可审计输出。
constraints: 当前环境 Python 3.13.5 缺少 sklearn/statsmodels/scipy；ARIMA 使用 NumPy 差分回归 fallback，Granger p 值使用本地不完全 Beta 实现并标记为 exploratory
当前 Q2 的趋势外推是探索性基线，不把相关或 Granger 统计量解释为物理因果
algorithm: code/reproduce_himcm.py：读取 CSV，按时间切分，拟合线性 baseline、指数模型、透明 Logistic 网格模型和 NumPy ARIMA(1,1,0) fallback，计算训练/末端回测指标、十年增量、温度阈值、Pearson 关联、滞后 OLS F 统计量及指数增长率敏感性。

evidence.value: Q1 PoC reproduced from CSV with time-ordered holdout; exponential test RMSE is lower than linear baseline

Q2 temperature trend, threshold years, Pearson correlation and exploratory lagged F statistics reproduced from the aligned CSV series
Granger p values and threshold standard errors with 95% year intervals are finite and recorded
Exponential growth-rate sensitivity at minus 10 percent, baseline and plus 10 percent is recorded
Five required figures were regenerated and visually checked
